title: Copilot Studio: share agents with other makers on the Microsoft Copilot harness
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, sharing controls, administrator roles and quoted licensing prerequisites are supported. It explicitly reports the conflicting Microsoft descriptions of viewer access rather than presenting one as definitive.

claims.where: What's changing: source disagreement; Open questions
claims.claim: Neither the sharing page nor the roadmap explains the mapping between roadmap Agent Viewer and Editor and the sharing page's terminology.
claims.quote: Searched: "Microsoft Copilot harness" "Agent Viewer" "Editor" license sharing; read roadmap, authoring-share-agent and admin-sharing-controls-limits. Classic admin-share-bots describes Agent Viewer evaluations, but does not reconcile the harness page's terms.

claims.claim: Control how agents are shared defines makers with Viewer assignment as only able to chat with the agent.
claims.quote: makers with the Viewer assignment can only chat with the agent.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Security & identity
claims.claim: An Editor can change agent instructions and tools as part of configuring the agent.
claims.quote: Build: Configure the agent's identity, knowledge, tools, skills, model, and memory. Instructions: Define the agent's identity, tone, scope, and behavior.

claims.claim: The sharing page warns that external-service connections can be tied to individual agent users' identities.
claims.quote: Sharing Copilot Studio agents that have connections to external services such as Azure Databricks Genie can be challenging because connections are tied to the identity of each individual agent user.

claims.claim: A shared agent might work for its maker but not other users because of those connections.
claims.quote: This means an agent might work for you but not for other users.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; rationale: risk
claims.claim: When tools use maker credentials, other agent users can perform operations with those credentials' permissions.
claims.quote: When an agent uses such a connection, other users of the agent can perform operations by using the permissions associated with the maker's credentials.

claims.claim: Tools configured for end-user credentials use each user's own connection at runtime.
claims.quote: Connections configured to use end-user credentials aren't subject to this connection-sharing restriction because each user authenticates by using their own connection at runtime.

claims.claim: Editor permissions can be given only to individuals, not security groups.
claims.quote: Editor permissions can only be given to individual users. You can't grant Editor permissions to security groups.

claims.claim: The sharing article does not specify which instructions or knowledge configuration details viewers can see.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio harness shared agent viewer visible instructions knowledge configuration details approval editor publishing; read authoring-share-agent, overview and sharing-controls. The sharing page says view details, without specifying visible instructions or knowledge configuration.

claims.claim: No approval step is documented for a coeditor's changes to the agent.
claims.quote: Searched: "Copilot Studio" "Editor" "approval" agent changes share; read sharing pages and publish-overview/publish-agent excerpts. Catalog submission approval is documented separately; no approval step for coeditor edits or ordinary republishing was found.

claims.claim: Sharing rules are enforced when a user tries to share.

claims.claim: Sharing rules do not remove access held before the rules were applied.
claims.quote: This restriction doesn't impact any existing users who already have access to the app, flow, or agent before the application of the sharing rules.

claims.claim: Sharing-rule enforcement can take up to an hour after the rules are set.
claims.quote: After sharing rules are set in the Power Platform admin center, it may take up to an hour for them to start getting enforced.

claims.claim: Agent sharing limits apply only to agents requiring authentication.
claims.quote: Sharing limits only apply to agents that require authentication.

claims.claim: Sharing controls can be applied at scale through environment groups and rules.
claims.quote: you can apply the sharing controls at scale using Environment Groups and Rules in the Power Platform admin center.

claims.claim: The Power Platform admin center path is Manage > Environments > managed environment > Edit Managed Environments > Manage sharing > desired agent sharing rule.
claims.quote: select Manage. ... select Environments. ... select a managed environment. ... Edit Managed Environments. ... sharing rules are located in the Manage sharing section. ... Choose the desired settings

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls table and prose
claims.claim: Set-AdminPowerAppEnvironmentGovernanceConfiguration -EnvironmentName <EnvironmentId> -UpdatedGovernanceConfiguration $governanceConfiguration saves the environment's sharing configuration.
claims.quote:
# Save the updated managed environment settings
Set-AdminPowerAppEnvironmentGovernanceConfiguration -EnvironmentName <EnvironmentId> -UpdatedGovernanceConfiguration $governanceConfiguration

claims.where: controls[0].note; Governance controls table; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Let people grant Editor permissions when agents are shared controls sharing with individuals as Editors.
claims.quote: Let people grant Editor permissions when agents are shared ... When selected: Owners and editors can share with any individual as an editor. When not selected: Owners and editors can't share with an individual as an editor.

claims.claim: Let people grant Viewer permissions when agents are shared controls sharing with viewers and security groups.
claims.quote: Let people grant Viewer permissions when agents are shared ... When selected: Owners and editors can share with any individual as a viewer and any security group.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Only share with individuals (no security groups) restricts agent sharing to individual viewers instead of security groups.
claims.quote: Only share with individuals (no security groups) ... owners and editors can only share with individuals as viewers. They can't share with a security group. This control doesn't affect ... sharing with individuals as editors.

claims.claim: Limit number of viewers who can access each agent is an available agent sharing rule.
claims.quote: Limit number of viewers who can access each agent ... If Only share with individuals (no security groups) is selected, you can control the maximum number of viewers with whom an agent can be shared with.

claims.claim: These sharing rules are environment-scoped Managed Environments controls.
claims.quote: You configure the sharing limits for agents as a Managed Environments control in the Power Platform admin center. You can configure these controls for an individual Managed Environment

claims.where: summary; Governance controls; Why it matters
claims.claim: The Microsoft Copilot harness FAQ identifies Managed environment sharing controls and environment security groups as controls over who agents are shared with.
claims.quote: Admins govern it with four kinds of control ... Who agents are shared with: Managed environment sharing controls and environment security groups

claims.claim: Get-AdminPowerAppEnvironment -EnvironmentName <EnvironmentId> retrieves the environment in the sharing-limit script.
claims.quote:
# Retrieve the environment
$environment = Get-AdminPowerAppEnvironment -EnvironmentName <EnvironmentId>

claims.claim: The script assigns $environment.Internal.properties.governanceConfiguration to $governanceConfiguration.
claims.quote: $governanceConfiguration = $environment.Internal.properties.governanceConfiguration

claims.claim: The script uses Add-Member -MemberType NoteProperty -Name 'bot-authoringSharingDisabled' -Value True -Force on extendedSettings.
claims.quote: $governanceConfiguration.settings.extendedSettings | Add-Member -MemberType NoteProperty -Name 'bot-authoringSharingDisabled' -Value True -Force

claims.claim: That example turns off sharing with individuals as Editors, without disabling Viewer sharing.
claims.quote: Here's a PowerShell script that turns off the ability to share your agents with individuals as Editors. ... This control doesn't affect the ability of owners or editors to share with viewers.

claims.claim: The sharing-limit page documents bot-limitSharingMode for the security-group sharing restriction.
claims.quote: $governanceConfiguration.settings.extendedSettings | Add-Member -MemberType NoteProperty -Name 'bot-limitSharingMode' -Value "ExcludeSharingToSecurityGroups" -Force

claims.claim: The sharing-limit page documents bot-maxLimitUserSharing for the viewer limit.
claims.quote: Here's a PowerShell script that ... limits the number of viewers ... to 20. ... -Name 'bot-maxLimitUserSharing' -Value "20" -Force

claims.claim: Enabling or editing managed environments requires the Power Platform Administrator or Dynamics 365 Administrator role in Microsoft Entra ID.
claims.quote: To enable or edit managed environments, you need the Power Platform Administrator or Dynamics 365 Administrator role in Microsoft Entra ID.

claims.quote: Searched: Power Platform tenant agent sharing disable tenant settings API PowerShell bot sharing; read list-tenantsettings, sharing-limit pages, FAQ, PowerShell and agent-settings excerpts. Agent Builder org sharing is separate and still permits sharing to individuals.
